Hi David —

Thanks again for speaking with Amy. We have your on-site loop scheduled for today at 2:30pm PT (room A-3 / Zoom link in invite). Laura and I are set for the backend system design + hands-on coding. I attached the calendar invite and a brief take-home option in case anything comes up.

If anything changes on your end, quick options:
- We can swap the live coding to a recorded voice+screen walkthrough from you (30 min),
- Or convert the coding round to a take-home (24 hours) and do short sync debrief later.

Please confirm you can make 2:30pm PT. If not, tell me which option you prefer and we’ll rearrange.

Attachments: backend-interview-invite.ics (calendar), takehome-guidelines.pdf

Best,

David —

Totally understandable, thanks for the heads up and feel better. Recorded voice+screen walkthrough works for us. Two small asks so we can treat it like the live coding:
1) 20–30 minute recording with screen + audio, walk through your approach and key tradeoffs.
2) Include a short README (1–2 paragraphs) summarizing what you chose to implement and any shortcuts.

If you can get it to us by 5pm PT, Laura will watch and we’ll still do the 45min system-design touchpoint at 4:15pm PT (that one can be live if you're feeling up to it). If you can't do 5pm, the take-home is still an option with 24 hours.

Marissa / Laura / Connor — Laura, can you confirm you can take the coding evaluation asynchronously today if David sends the recording? Connor, tagging you in case we need to swap interviewers or adjust timing for scheduling.

David — calendar invite updated to reflect the plan and I attached the take-home guidelines in case you prefer that instead. Link to dropbox/drive or WeTransfer is fine.

Thanks —
Ben
